# ⚠️ Generated — do not edit these files

The files in this `css/` folder are **generated copies** of `frontend/css/`.
They exist here only so GitHub Pages (serving from the repo root) can find them.

**Edit `frontend/css/` instead.**
Run `sync.ps1` (or `sync.bat`) from the repo root to copy `frontend/*` into the root before committing.

If you add or rename a file in `frontend/css/`, also delete its old root copy — `sync.ps1` copies but does not prune (see the known-issue note in `../sync.ps1`).
